parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Process Approval request incomplete - please resubmit
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hello @{triggerBody()?['RequestorName']},

Your Process Approval request could not be processed because one or more required fields were empty (Request Title, Requestor Name, Requestor Email, Source Site/App Name).

Please resubmit the form with all required fields completed.

Set_hyperlink_columns.description: RequestURL and FormURL are hyperlink columns; set them via ValidateUpdateListItem so they work regardless of connector hyperlink support.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
A new Process Approval request was submitted for @{triggerBody()?['SourceSiteAppName']}, which already has request(s) on the list.

New item (marked Duplicate): #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']} - @{body('Create_item')?['Title']}

Existing item(s):

    @{join(body('Select_existing_item_links'), '')}

Submitted by @{triggerBody()?['RequestorName']} (@{triggerBody()?['RequestorEmail']}).

Thank you for your Process Approval request for @{triggerBody()?['SourceSiteAppName']} (request #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']}, Phase 1).

You can expect a response within 12–24 hours.

Hello @{triggerBody()?['RequestorName']},

Thank you for your Process Approval request for @{triggerBody()?['SourceSiteAppName']} (request #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']}, Phase 2).

You can expect a response within 12–24 hours.

Hello @{triggerBody()?['RequestorName']},

Thank you for your Process Approval request for @{triggerBody()?['SourceSiteAppName']} (request #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']}, Phase 3).

Requests in this phase require DTB Approval before they can proceed. We will be in touch once that has been obtained.

Hello @{triggerBody()?['RequestorName']},

Thank you for your Process Approval request for @{triggerBody()?['SourceSiteAppName']} (request #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']}, Phase 4).

Requests in this phase require DTB Approval before they can proceed. We will be in touch once that has been obtained.

Phase 4 – to be confirmed.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hello @{triggerBody()?['RequestorName']},

Your Process Approval request for @{triggerBody()?['SourceSiteAppName']} has been APPROVED.

Request Details:

  • Request Title: @{triggerBody()?['RequestTitle']}
  • Request ID: #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']}
  • Phase: @{outputs('Compose_Phase')}
  • Business Unit: @{triggerBody()?['RequestorBusinessUnit']}
  • Request Type: @{triggerBody()?['RequestType']}
  • Approver: @{coalesce(first(body('Start_and_wait_for_an_approval')?['responses'])?['responder']?['displayName'], 'Approver')}
  • Approver Comments: @{if(empty(coalesce(first(body('Start_and_wait_for_an_approval')?['responses'])?['comments'], '')), 'None provided', coalesce(first(body('Start_and_wait_for_an_approval')?['responses'])?['comments'], ''))}

You can view the request record in SharePoint: View Request #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']}

Kind regards,
Process Approval Team

Hello @{triggerBody()?['RequestorName']},

Your Process Approval request for @{triggerBody()?['SourceSiteAppName']} has been REJECTED.

Request Details:

  • Request Title: @{triggerBody()?['RequestTitle']}
  • Request ID: #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']}
  • Phase: @{outputs('Compose_Phase')}
  • Approver: @{coalesce(first(body('Start_and_wait_for_an_approval')?['responses'])?['responder']?['displayName'], 'Approver')}
  • Reason / Comments: @{if(empty(coalesce(first(body('Start_and_wait_for_an_approval')?['responses'])?['comments'], '')), 'No comments provided', coalesce(first(body('Start_and_wait_for_an_approval')?['responses'])?['comments'], ''))}

You can review the request record in SharePoint: View Request #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']}

If you have questions regarding this decision, please contact the approver or your department lead.

Kind regards,
Process Approval Team

Test run of the Process Approval flow. No approval or requestor emails were sent.

  • Item: #@{body('Create_item')?['ID']} - @{body('Create_item')?['Title']}
  • Final status: Approved (Test mode - approval skipped)
  • Phase: @{outputs('Compose_Phase')}
  • Duplicate: @{outputs('Compose_IsDuplicate')}
  • Requestor: @{triggerBody()?['RequestorName']} (@{triggerBody()?['RequestorEmail']})
  • Business unit: @{triggerBody()?['RequestorBusinessUnit']}
  • Request type: @{triggerBody()?['RequestType']}
  • Alignment (Teams / SharePoint / Others): @{triggerBody()?['AlignmentChangeTeams']} / @{triggerBody()?['AlignmentChangeSharePoint']} / @{triggerBody()?['AlignmentChangeOthers']}
  • Source site / app: @{triggerBody()?['SourceSiteAppName']}
  • Request URL: @{triggerBody()?['RequestURL']}
  • Hyperlink update step: @{if(equals(actions('Set_hyperlink_columns')?['status'], 'Succeeded'), 'OK', 'FAILED - check run')}

The requestor would have received the @{outputs('Compose_Phase')} acknowledgement email.
